About MedCare

A hospital the city
has trusted for 20 years

Founded in 2005, MedCare began as a 20-bed nursing home in Hazratganj. Today we are a 120-bed multispeciality hospital — but our way of working has not changed: the right treatment, explained honestly, at a fair price.

  • Senior consultants in every major speciality — no rotation of juniors
  • Written estimates before every procedure, with no hidden charges
  • Cashless tie-ups with all major insurance providers and TPAs
  • Infection-controlled modular operation theatres and ICU
120 BedsModular OTCath LabICU & NICU24×7 PharmacyAmbulanceDialysis Unit

Why MedCare

Care that is honest,
not just advanced

Technology matters, but trust matters more. Here is what patients tell us they value most.

Transparent Billing

Written estimates before treatment and itemised bills. What we quote is what you pay.

24×7 Emergency

A full emergency team, ICU and ambulance — at 3 in the afternoon or 3 in the morning.

Senior Doctors Only

Your case is handled by the consultant you booked — not handed over to juniors.

Cashless Insurance

Tie-ups with all major insurers and TPAs. Our desk handles the paperwork for you.
